summary: Custer County, ID cabin lookout in the Challis NF from the 1930s; two lookout listings say it is gone; a trail listing says a trail passes the point.

facts.status_note: Two lookout listings (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts) say gone; the Forest Lookouts listing gives only the 1930s cabin; no source describes what remains at the site

access.note: Hike-in site; a trail listing describes a moderate one-way trail in Salmon-Challis National Forest that goes by the point

visit.trail_note: Hike-in; trail listed as Rookie Point via Yankee Fork Road

evidence.supports: cabin from the 1930s, listed as gone
Idaho listing marks the site gone and hike-in
trail titled Rookie Point via Yankee Fork Road
evidence.quote: Rookie Point via Yankee Fork Road

evidence.supports: moderate one-way trail in Salmon-Challis National Forest
evidence.quote: This is a moderate one way trail in Salmon-Challis National Forest.
This trail goes by Flat Rock Campground and Rookie Point

sources.title: Rookie Point via Yankee Fork Road

notes_for_editor: Gone status is on two lookout listings (firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts); the Forest Lookouts listing gives only the 1930s cabin and does not say gone. Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history, so no staffing is stated. The Gaia GPS page is a user-built trail listing: it shows a trail passes the point, not what is there. No source read describes remains, so the story says so.
